name: To Die With Ben
source:
In the game you will meet with a terrible virus that was clearly waiting for an opportunity to prove himself. Your main goal is to survive at any cost. Sometimes the most provocative answers he reacts condescendingly, and sometimes even careful questions can cause aggression in him so choose wisely. Although for some this game is just a chance to meet a favorite character.

https://mitch-is-not-disclosed.itch.io/to-die-with-ben (Itch.io page)
